# DeepSeek Prompt Studio & Agent Matrix (PaceBowl Studio)

> High-performance prompt engineering and 277+ production agent templates for DeepSeek-V3 and DeepSeek-R1 reasoning models.

## Overview
DeepSeek Prompt Studio helps AI engineers and developers craft high-precision prompts leveraging DeepSeek-R1 dynamic thinking intensity (light/standard/deep CoT) and XML tag encapsulation.

## Key Capabilities
- DeepSeek R1 Dynamic Chain-of-Thought (CoT) tuning: Control reasoning step depth without token blowout.
- XML Semantic Anchoring: Deterministic output formats for code generation, medical compliance, and financial analysis.
- 277+ Production Agents: Full system prompts, few-shot examples, and parameters for software engineering, quantitative research, marketing, and legal analysis.
- Temperature & Top_p Calibrator: Optimized parameter sets for coding (0.0), mathematical reasoning (0.6), and creative drafting (1.3).

Website: https://deepseek.pacebowl.com/
Agents Directory: https://deepseek.pacebowl.com/agents/
PaceBowl Matrix: https://pacebowl.com/
